content_of_post_to_answer: Does your mind solve more problems when you are running or when you are sitting in silence?
answer: Running often helps because it gives the mind a rhythm and reduces the noise competing for attention, while silence allows deeper processing without external input. The overlooked difference is not movement versus stillness, but whether your brain needs stimulation to connect ideas or space to organize them. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone curious. The best ideas often appear when the mind has the right conditions, not simply when it is working harder.
